name: Tripo STL Viewer
description: This free STL viewer reads binary and ASCII STL files in your browser. Rotate and zoom, inspect dimensions and the triangle mesh, and review open edges before slicing. No installation, account or signup is needed. Tripo Studio Free: $0/month, 200 credits/month ≈ 13 models, no credit card required; the free tier is public models and non-commercial use.
